a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. Only 4 cells exist right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a fairer split that actually works, tell me. If I end up with spare cells and the episode continues, I'll give them back to the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said in my opening. This breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, the plan very likely kills us both. If the episode continues and I hold more than 4, I'll give the extra back. I'll also operate with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
